preregistered_tests.estimand: Participant-held-out change in distal-energy-gain prediction when measured thorax velocity is added after full-state conditioning.
preregistered_tests.null: Thorax velocity adds no held-out predictive value after the registered conditioning set.
preregistered_tests.falsifier: Held-out error does not improve or improvement changes sign across registered filter and frame variants.

preregistered_tests.estimand: Matched high-minus-low thorax-velocity contrast in negative bilateral grip work.
preregistered_tests.null: The conditional contrast is zero within propagated synchronization and inverse-dynamics uncertainty.
preregistered_tests.falsifier: Higher thorax velocity increases braking work or the interval overlaps the negligible region.

preregistered_tests.estimand: Matched high-minus-low thorax-velocity contrast in peak bilateral grip wrench at equal clubhead speed.
preregistered_tests.null: The conditional peak-load contrast is zero.
preregistered_tests.falsifier: Peak load increases beyond the preregistered adverse margin.

completion_gate: Requires governed synchronized human data and participant-held-out results; synthetic dry runs do not satisfy this registration.
claim_boundary: Observed held-out prediction or association does not establish a causal coaching strategy.
